remaining_cautions.note: Primary Table 1/PDF text reports all DM peptide sequences with C-terminal amidation; DRAMP encodes this, while DBAASP/CAMP/dbAMP local sequence snapshots expose sequence letters without normalizing -NH2.

Some DBAASP FIC rows omit partner/group context, and CAMP/dbAMP rows collapse primary table values into broad database text labels. These are retained as conflicts, not promoted to clean source verification.
Ten staged supplementary .bin files were checked and are duplicate Nature article HTML landing pages; no local PDF/XLSX/CSV supplementary data table was available or needed to resolve Tables 2-6.
TEM supports structural disruption and FIC/time-kill support phenotypes, but no single molecular binding target is claimed.
